Agent Name: StreamingService_Expert  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake:  
The first clear mistake is at step 7, where the StreamingService_Expert concludes that **Enduring Love (2004) is not currently available on Netflix (US)** based on search results that only show generic streaming availability pages and do not actually rule out Netflix US. This is an unsupported negative inference. More importantly, this premature filtering can directly lead to the wrong final answer, because the agent fails to keep potentially qualifying movies in consideration and later does not complete the full comparison across all candidates.
